file.reason: Heroicons uses 'document' for a generic file icon (blank page). Exact match.

document.reason: Heroicons 'document-text' shows a page with text lines, matching 'text document'.

pdf.reason: No PDF-specific icon in Heroicons. 'document' is too generic to be a good match.

new-folder.reason: Heroicons 'folder-plus' is a folder with a plus sign. Exact semantic match.

archive.reason: Heroicons 'archive-box' represents an archive/box. Good match.

zip.reason: No compressed file or zip icon in Heroicons.

attachment.reason: Heroicons 'paper-clip' is the standard attachment/paperclip icon. Exact match.

unlink.reason: Heroicons added 'link-slash' to represent a broken/removed link. Added in v2.1.

image.reason: Heroicons uses 'photo' for an image/picture icon. Exact semantic match.

gallery.reason: No multi-image or gallery icon in Heroicons. 'photo' is singular only.

video.reason: Heroicons uses 'video-camera' for video. Also has 'film' but video-camera is more standard.

camera-off.reason: Heroicons has 'video-camera-slash' but no 'camera-slash' or camera-off equivalent for still cameras.

volume.reason: Heroicons 'speaker-wave' shows a speaker with sound waves. Good match for volume on.

volume-low.reason: No low-volume speaker variant in Heroicons. Only 'speaker-wave' (full) and 'speaker-x-mark' (muted).

mute.reason: Heroicons 'speaker-x-mark' shows a speaker with an X. Exact match for muted.

music.reason: Heroicons 'musical-note' represents music/audio. Exact semantic match.

microphone-off.reason: No microphone-off or microphone-slash icon confirmed in Heroicons v2.

broadcast.reason: Heroicons 'signal' represents wireless/broadcast signal. Reasonable match for broadcast/live.

rotate.reason: No rotate icon in Heroicons. 'arrow-path' is a loop, not a rotation.

play.reason: Direct match. Standalone play triangle icon.

stop.reason: No standalone 'stop' icon exists. 'stop-circle' (stop inside a circle) is the closest available.

skip-next.reason: Heroicons 'forward' represents skip to next track. Good match.

skip-previous.reason: Heroicons 'backward' represents skip to previous track. Good match.

fast-forward.reason: No fast-forward icon in Heroicons. 'forward' is skip-next, not fast-forward.

rewind.reason: No rewind icon in Heroicons. 'backward' is skip-previous, not rewind.

repeat.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-path' shows circular arrows forming a loop. Reasonable match for repeat/loop.

record.reason: No record icon (filled circle) in Heroicons.

brush.reason: Heroicons 'paint-brush' is a brush/paint icon. Exact semantic match.

pen.reason: Heroicons has 'pencil' (simple pencil) and 'pencil-square' (pencil with square). 'pencil' is the better match for a drawing/pen tool.

color.reason: Heroicons 'eye-dropper' is a color picker/eyedropper tool. Exact semantic match.
